table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Type = T.Type,
	SupplierCategory = T.SupplierCategory,
	SuppCode=T.SuppCode, 
	AliasName = T.AliasName,
	SupplierName=T.SupplierName, 
	Address1=T.Address1, 
	Address2=T.Address2, 
	Amount = SUM(T.Amount)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		Type = 'P',
		SupplierCategory = SC.Name,
		SuppCode=PL.SuppCode, 
		AliasName = AC.AliasName,
		SupplierName=AC.Name, 
		Address1=S.Address1, 
		Address2=S.Address2, 
		Amount = SUM(PL.InvTotal)
	FROM 
		SupplierCategory SC, PurLedger PL, Accounts AC, Supplier S
	WHERE
		PL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		PL.SuppCode = AC.AccCode AND
		AC.AccCode = S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCatCode = SC.SuppCatCode AND
		SC.SuppCatCode IN (:ai_suppcatcode)
	GROUP BY
		SC.Name,
		PL.SuppCode, 
		AC.AliasName,
		AC.Name, 
		S.Address1, 
		S.Address2
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		Type = 'R',
		SupplierCategory = SC.Name,
		SuppCode=PL.SuppCode, 
		AliasName = AC.AliasName,
		SupplierName=AC.Name, 
		Address1=S.Address1, 
		Address2=S.Address2, 
		Amount = -SUM(PL.InvTotal)
	FROM 
		SupplierCategory SC, PrLedger PL, Accounts AC, Supplier S
	WHERE
		PL.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		PL.SuppCode = AC.AccCode AND
		AC.AccCode = S.SuppCode AND
		S.SuppCatCode = SC.SuppCatCode AND
		SC.SuppCatCode IN (:ai_suppcatcode)
	GROUP BY
		SC.Name,
		PL.SuppCode, 
		AC.AliasName,
		AC.Name, 
		S.Address1, 
		S.Address2) T
GROUP BY
	T.Type,
	T.SupplierCategory,
	T.SuppCode, 
	T.AliasName,
	T.SupplierName, 
	T.Address1, 
	T.Address2
ORDER BY 
	SupplierCategory,
	SupplierName
